pkgmetadata.longdescription: PhotoCraft AI is an unofficial community fork of PhotoCraft, the open-source native image editor written in Rust, with AI image editing built into the interface. Edits run through a ChatGPT subscription via the Codex CLI or through user-supplied Gemini, FLUX and Seedream API keys. Includes the photocraft-cli headless converter.

use.flag: Open HEIC/HEIF photos with the pure-Rust heic-rs decoder
